item.title: CVE-2026-132601 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1 | A security vulnerability has been detected in SEO Panel 6.0.0. item.title: CVE-2026-104357 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.8
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.8 | A flaw was found in libtirpc. The SunRPC UDP/datagram server transport reuses a single receive buffer across requests and resets the XDR decode position without rebinding the decode length to the size of the datagram actually received. As a result, when a short UDP RPC request is received after a longer one, the XDR decoder can read stale bytes left in the reused buffer and interpret them as part of the current request, including credential, verifier, or procedure-argument fields. The highest threat from this vulnerability is to data confidentiality and integrity for services that use a UDP-based SunRPC server.

item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.1 | A flaw was found in nbdkit. A crafted QCOW2 image with ZSTD-compressed clusters can trigger a heap over-read, leading to a denial of service and potentially exposing heap memory.

item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The NextScripts: Social Networks Auto-Poster plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via 'comment_author' and 'comment_agent' Comment Fields in all versions up to, and including, 4.4.8 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. item.title: CVE-2026-109555 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.0
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.0 | The WP STAGING and WP STAGING Pro plugins for WordPress are vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 4.17.0 and 6.17.0, respectively, via deserialization of untrusted input during database restore and staging reset. This is due to the database importer treating attacker-controlled text beginning with {WPSTG_BINARY} as trusted internal binary data and decoding its hexadecimal suffix into serialized bytes. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to plant a malicious serialized object in their own profile. When an Administrator later performs an ordinary database-including restore or staging reset containing that value, and the restored profile metadata is loaded, either during the restore or in a later request, a built-in POP chain can be used to execute arbitrary code on the server. Additional built-in gadget chains allow arbitrary local file read in both WP STAGING and WP STAGING Pro and arbitrary file deletion in WP STAGING Pro. The attacker does not require Administrator credentials or a copy of a backup, but exploitation does require the later privileged restore or reset.

item.title: CVE-2026-117678 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description:
Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Inefficient Algorithmic Complexity vulnerability in benoitc idna allows an attacker who controls a hostname passed to the library to exhaust CPU via an over-long xn-- label. idna:ulabel/1 in src/idna.erl hands every ASCII label that starts with xn-- to punycode:decode/1 without applying check_label_length/1, the 63-octet DNS label limit. punycode:decode/1 in src/punycode.erl builds its output with list appends in insert/4, so its cost grows super-linearly with the label length. A label of a few kilobytes keeps a scheduler busy for seconds to minutes before the label is rejected as invalid punycode.
Every decode entry point reaches this path: decode/1, decode/2, to_unicode/1 and from_ascii/1. The encode path reaches it as well, because alabel/1 calls ulabel/1 on an ASCII xn-- label before its own length check, so encode/1, encode/2 and to_ascii/1 are affected for such input.
This issue affects idna: from 0.5.0 before 8.0.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-19609 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description:
Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | Cross-site scripting in the embedded co-browsing feature in Unblu inc. Unblu Spark 7.0 through 7.57.9 and 8.0 before 8.40.2, on on-premises and cloud deployments, allows an unauthenticated remote attacker in the visitor role to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the browser of an agent taking part in the attacker's co-browsing session, via manipulated synchronized page attributes of the co-browsed page.
